# spikes/s1a/scripts/Start-Spike.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Steps 2 to 4 of the spike runbook: resource group and same-day policy exemption, the Bicep deployment, your Foundry roles, and the Claude deployments (coordinator, Hosts, and the extra models the Hosts agent is compared on).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-RunId` | string | yes |  |  |
| `-ResourceGroupLocation` | string | no | `'northcentralus'` |  |
| `-Location` | string | no | `'eastus2'` |  |
| `-CoordinatorModel` | string | no | `'claude-haiku-5-5'` |  |
| `-HostsModel` | string | no | `'claude-opus-5-5'` |  |
| `-CoordinatorVersion` | string | no |  |  |
| `-HostsVersion` | string | no |  |  |
| `-CompareModels` | string[] | no | `@('claude-sonnet-5-5')` | Also deployed so Q6 can run the Hosts agent on each model. The coordinator's model is reused, not deployed twice. |
| `-OrganizationName` | string | no |  | Foundry sends these to Anthropic with every Claude deployment (modelProviderData). Empty means the tenant's own organization name and country from Graph. |
| `-CountryCode` | string | no |  |  |
| `-Industry` | string | no | `'technology'` |  |
| `-Capacity` | int | no | `50` | Thousands of tokens per minute per deployment. 1 is too small: one agent call with tool results exceeds it. |
| `-Provider` | string | no | `'Foundry'` | Anthropic: the fallback without Foundry (Anthropic's API from a Container App, Entra Agent ID through Graph). No API key: the agents app calls Claude with Anthropic workload identity federation (its managed identity). |
